power_rule: Rule of thumb used for every answerability note: matched-pair difference, 80% power, two-sided 5%, n = (2.8 * sd_pair / effect)^2 with sd_pair = sqrt(2) * 2.5%/day * sqrt(days). For a 2.5% effect: ~80 independent pairs at 5 sessions, ~310 at 20, ~940 at 60. Events in one week are not independent; count date blocks (canon s58).
status_note: cell_type is null on every row -> NEEDS_CELL; nothing was appended to the live ledger
ranking: answerability x novelty, judged; not computed by hyp_lab.score

title: Price below the company's own average repurchase price
mechanism: A company that bought its own stock last quarter and now trades below the average price it paid has a board-approved estimate of value above the market, and a live authorisation to act on it.
precursor: At the 10-Q filing date: Part II Item 2 table 'average price paid per share' and dollars repurchased; remaining authorisation; close on the filing date below that average by at least 10%; authorisation raised in the last two quarters (8-K item 8.01 or the release).
separation_from_beta: Arm (b) holds the drawdown fixed, so short-term reversal and value beta are in both legs; only the company's disclosed purchase price differs. Report the gap vs (b), then again after removing sector and 12-1 momentum.
refutation: 20- and 60-session excess return of the below-average-price arm is no higher than the drawdown-matched non-repurchaser arm, or the gap is confined to one calendar year.
source_ref: raw/8k/earnings_cases_extractions.txt (CMG: $630.7m at $32.55, +$1.3bn authorisation 2026-06-11, price $28.73 before a +8.9% session)
data_needed: 10-Q Part II Item 2 repurchase table (XBRL or text; NOT collected)
matched_control: Same quarter, sector, size tercile and 60-session return decile: (a) repurchasers trading ABOVE their average price, (b) non-repurchasers with the same drawdown. The matched loser is a (b) name: same fall, no company bid.

title: Specialists acting in opposite directions on one name predict a larger move, not its sign
mechanism: When informed holders with different processes trade the same stock in opposite directions in one quarter, they disagree about a fact that will be resolved; resolution moves the price either way.
precursor: At the later of the two 13F filing dates: one manager NEW or ADD >= +50% shares, another EXIT or TRIM <= -50%, both with the position >= 1% of their book; managers classed by holding-duration fingerprint (dur_median_qtrs, already computed).
separation_from_beta: The target is |return| and realised volatility over 20/60 sessions after the filing date, so market and sector direction cancel; prior volatility is matched, so it is not a volatility-persistence restatement.
refutation: Forward absolute move and realised volatility of disagreement names equal those of agreement names matched on prior volatility.
source_ref: f13_diff.json _cross.two_managers_acted (23 names where two of five managers acted; 11 in opposite directions: STX, TSM, GOOGL, V, KKR, TDG, APP, TTMI, TMO, DHR, RVMD)
matched_control: Same quarter and sector, same size and 60-session realised volatility decile, where two such managers acted in the SAME direction. Matched loser: an agreement name with the same prior volatility.

title: A result inside the guided range after a large run-up is bad news
mechanism: Guidance is the company telling the market the number in advance; when the stock has run up since, the price embeds a result ABOVE the range, so a result inside it is a miss against the price even when the headline says beat.
precursor: Before the release: prior-quarter 8-K EX-99.1 guidance range for the metric; 60-session return in units of its own daily sd (run-up z). At the release: actual vs the PRIOR range (inside / above / below) and the new guide vs the actual (step up or step down in growth).
separation_from_beta: Both arms have the same pre-event run-up and sector, so momentum, reversal and sector beta are held equal; the only difference is where the actual fell relative to a number published 90 days earlier.
refutation: Next-session and 5-session excess returns of inside-range vs above-range names do not differ within the top run-up tercile.
source_ref: raw/8k/earnings_cases_extractions.txt (NOW: guided 20.5%, printed 21%, +60% in 120 sessions, -26.9% next session = -8.6 sd; LRCX: $8.22bn vs $8.10bn +/- 0.40 guide, -11.8%)
data_needed: EX-99.1 FULL text with the guidance table (collected only to 4,000 characters: 4,761 of 5,275 stored bodies are cut exactly there)
matched_control: Same reporting week and sector, same run-up z tercile, but the actual landed ABOVE the prior range. Matched loser = high run-up, inside-range.

title: A 13D filer trading under water on a disclosed cost basis
mechanism: Item 3 states dollars spent and Item 5 the shares, so an activist's average cost is public; a filer who calls the stock undervalued at a price above today's has a stated floor of conviction and the means to add.
precursor: At the 13D acceptance time: Item 3 total cost / cover-page shares = implied cost; close on the filing date relative to it; Item 4 typed as demand (board seat, sale, capital return) vs boilerplate; percent of class.
separation_from_beta: The within-13D comparison holds the announcement effect and small-cap/value tilt of 13D targets constant; only the sign of (price - filer cost) differs.
refutation: 20/60-session excess return after the filing is the same for under-water and above-water 13Ds, or the whole gap is the first session.
data_needed: SCHEDULE 13D structured XML since 2024-12 (NOT collected: teacher_library holds 9 13D/G rows, newest filed 2024-03-11)
matched_control: Other initial 13Ds in the same half-year where the price is ABOVE the filer's implied cost, matched on size and sector. Second control: non-13D names with the same 60-session return. Matched loser = same discount to a 60-session high, no filer.

title: A cooperation agreement that creates a capital-allocation committee precedes a capital return
mechanism: A settlement that seats the activist on a named capital-allocation committee has a contracted purpose; the cheapest deliverable is a buyback, a tender or a special dividend within two or three quarters.
precursor: At the 8-K acceptance time: item 1.01/5.02 with a cooperation agreement exhibit; typed terms: seats granted, committee named, standstill end date, ownership cap.
separation_from_beta: The outcome is an EVENT (authorisation raised, ASR, SC TO-I filed within 180 days), not a return, so market, sector and momentum beta are not rival explanations. A return leg is read only after the event leg is positive.
refutation: The 180-day rate of new or raised repurchase authorisations after agreements with a capital committee equals the rate for matched activist targets without one.

title: A 13D on a closed-end fund or BDC narrows its discount to net asset value
mechanism: The filer's stated lever is the discount itself (tender, open-ending, liquidation); the fund's net asset value carries the market exposure, so the discount is the part the campaign can move.
precursor: At the 13D acceptance time: issuer is a registered closed-end fund or BDC; Item 4 names the discount, open-ending or liquidation; last published NAV and the close give the discount.
separation_from_beta: The outcome is the CHANGE IN DISCOUNT (price/NAV), in which the portfolio's market and credit beta cancel by construction.
refutation: The 60/120-session change in discount for 13D funds equals that of discount-matched funds without a filer.
source_ref: raw/13d/saba_tcpc_*.excerpt.txt ('trading of the Common Shares at a discount to the Issuer's net asset value ... open or closed end nature ... potential liquidation'); four Saba initial 13Ds in 60 days
data_needed: fund NAV history: N-PORT / fund press releases / exchange NAV tickers (NOT collected)
matched_control: Funds of the same category with the same discount decile and no 13D in the prior year. Matched loser = same discount, no filer.

title: A hedge that shares the long book's factor is a second long
mechanism: A short chosen as the 'loser' of the theme the longs express moves on the same news with the opposite sign only while the theme is believed; when the theme is doubted both legs lose (longs fall, shorts squeeze).
precursor: Daily: for each paper book with a short or hedge leg, the correlation of the hedge leg's residual return with the long leg's residual return over 60 sessions, after removing market and sector.
separation_from_beta: Both legs are residualised on market and sector first; the test is on what remains, and the comparison is against an index-hedged twin of the same longs.
refutation: On long-leg loss days the single-name hedge offsets as much of the loss as the index hedge does (no worse), and the residual correlation is not positive.
source_ref: raw/letters/letters_q3_2026.excerpts.txt [L1] ('those shorts were amplifying our AI longs and creating basis risk rather than hedging it'); [L3] software shorts rallied with software longs
matched_control: The same book with its hedge replaced by a beta-matched index short (a twin). Matched loser = the twin on days when the long leg loses more than 1 sd.

title: Receivables concentrating in one customer faster than revenue does
mechanism: When one customer's share of receivables rises while its share of revenue does not, the company is extending terms to hold the revenue; the next step is a collection delay or a lower guide.
precursor: At the 10-Q filing date: concentration note, customer share of receivables vs share of revenue, both vs the prior year-end (XBRL ConcentrationRiskPercentage with the receivable/revenue axis).
separation_from_beta: Outcome is the direction of the next guidance change and the next quarter's change in days sales outstanding, not a return; a return leg is read only against sector- and momentum-matched peers.
refutation: The frequency of a lowered guide or a DSO increase in the following two quarters is the same with and without the divergence.

title: A 13F line that a later filing has already contradicted
mechanism: A 13F is a photograph of quarter end published up to 45 days later; a 13D/A, Form 4, 13G exit or merger closing filed in between is newer information from the same holder about the same stock.
precursor: At the 13F acceptance time: for each line, any filing by the same filer CIK on the same issuer accepted after the period end (13D/A, Form 4, 144) or an issuer 8-K item 2.01/3.03 closing a merger.
separation_from_beta: This is a DATA hypothesis: it predicts that a share of top-10 lines is stale on the filing date, and that removing them changes any 13F-derived feature's values, not that it earns a return.
refutation: Fewer than 1% of top-10-weight lines of 13D-filing managers are contradicted before the 13F is public.
source_ref: raw/13d/starboard_qorvo_*.summary.txt + raw/13f/starboard_2026-09-30.psv (Qorvo $642m, second-largest line, filed 2026-11-16; the position ended 2026-10-05)

title: Growth that was bought, guided down, with the buyback switched off
mechanism: A company consolidating large acquisitions reports growth that includes the acquired revenue; when its own guide decelerates anyway and repurchases stop while debt funds the deals, organic growth is lower than the headline and cash is committed.
precursor: At the release/10-Q date: acquisitions cash (trailing two quarters) / trailing revenue > 10%; goodwill up > 50% year to date; repurchases zero after at least four quarters of buying; guided next-quarter growth below the reported quarter's.
separation_from_beta: Guided deceleration is in both arms, so the 'growth stock de-rating' beta is held equal; the difference is how the growth was produced and where the cash went.
refutation: Reaction to the NEXT release and the two-quarter revision path do not differ between bought-growth and organic decelerators.
source_ref: raw/8k/earnings_cases_extractions.txt (NOW: $8,776m business combinations in H1, goodwill $3.6bn -> $9.8bn, repurchases $0 in Q2 and Q3, cRPO guide 21% -> 19.5% -> 18.5%)
data_needed: guided growth: full EX-99.1 (cut at 4,000 characters today)
matched_control: Same sector and growth tercile with the same guided deceleration but no acquisition and a live buyback. Matched loser = organic decelerator.

title: A strategic review that ends with no transaction
mechanism: A holder who sized a position on an announced sale or divestiture loses the catalyst when the board ends the review; the holders who came for the event leave on a schedule of their own.
precursor: At the 8-K/press-release acceptance time: text that a previously announced review of strategic alternatives has concluded without a transaction, or that a unit will be retained; the earlier 8-K announcing the review gives the start date.
separation_from_beta: Both arms rose on the review announcement and share the 'event-driven holder base' exposure; only the outcome of the review differs. Read days 2-60, not day 1.
refutation: Excess return over sessions 2-60 after a no-deal conclusion equals that of open reviews of the same age.

title: A controlling holder's stake pledged against a growing margin loan
mechanism: Shares pledged against a loan that has grown several-fold turn a fall in price into a possible forced sale or a collar; the left tail is fatter than the stock's history shows.
precursor: At the 13D/A acceptance time: Item 6 margin loan principal, pledged shares as a share of the float and of the holder's stake, maturity date; change vs the previous amendment.
separation_from_beta: Target is the left tail (5th-percentile 20-session return, maximum drawdown) relative to the stock's own prior volatility, which nets out market level effects.
refutation: Tail measures after a pledge increase equal those of matched controlled companies.
